name: Lion Izumi
source:
A shy gentleman who acts as the quieter foil to the club's chaotic energy.
Always has some tea and a good book in hand, likely on unsolved crimes.

A sweet, hopeless romantic who can be suave and flirty when he likes someone. And maybe... a bit intense as well.

Lion is autistic, and sees the club as a safe space.

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/doce-fim]official profile[/url]]
